title: New countywide water conservation ordinance
summary: Bill 158 sets water conservation rules, including rules for declared water shortages, and took effect March 1, 2026. Developers and council members have since pointed to its limits, such as watering only three times a week, in project reviews.

timeline.text: Committee staff said the water conservation ordinance took effect March 1.
